id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|434c: "I'm a Sniflheim soldier. To secure this area, my brother and I were clearing out killing machines.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|442c: "Then a red upgraded unit, a Type G, appeared in the pack. A murder machine that kills without a thought.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|454c: "We brothers fought desperately and somehow drove it off. ...But the price was heavy.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4614: "Its onslaught killed my brother, and I was gravely wounded. I can't move for a good while.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46e4: "My brother was my only family. We'd lived on, just the two of us. I'll never forgive the Type G that killed him.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|47c4: "By any means necessary, I'll destroy every Type G in this world. I'll make them taste my brother's pain.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4894: "...You look pretty strong. I'll pay you well. Since I can't move, could you defeat a Type G for me?
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49bc: "I see, that's a shame. But I'll never forgive them. I will destroy every Type G...
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b28: "Really?! That's a big help. Here's what I know about Type G: it always moves with its killing machine underlings.

id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|553c: "Yes, this is its part. Heh. How does it feel to suffer the same pain as my brother...
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5600: "Thank you for listening to a stranger's request. But I'm sorry. I've decided to stop destroying Type Gs.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|56b8: "Seeing the Type-G part just now, I realized something.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5704: "Living for revenge, I'd become a killing machine just like the Type G.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|57a4: "Consumed by hatred in front of me, I lost sight of what I should do. What I really should do is honor my brother...
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5884: "But thanks to you, I realized it. From now on I'll devote my life to honoring my brother. Thanks for everything. Take this.
id./param/region/r013.pack|npc_ie.bxon|59d8: "Oh, it's you. Thanks for the other day. From now on I'll live my own life properly, not for revenge.

tm.「ヤツの猛攻により 弟は殺され\n オレは 重傷を負って\n 当分 動けない身体: "Its onslaught killed my brother, and I was gravely wounded. I can't move for a good while.
tm.「弟は たったひとりの肉親だった。\n オレたちは ずっと ふたりで生きてきたん: "My brother was my only family. We'd lived on, just the two of us. I'll never forgive the Type G that killed him.
tm.「オレは どんな手を使っても\n この世界のタイプＧを すべて破壊してみせる。\: "By any means necessary, I'll destroy every Type G in this world. I'll make them taste my brother's pain.
tm.「……あんた かなり強そうだな。\n 礼をはずむから 動けない オレの代わりに\: "...You look pretty strong. I'll pay you well. Since I can't move, could you defeat a Type G for me?
tm.「そうか それは残念だ。\n だが オレは 絶対にヤツらを許さねえ。\n 必ず: "I see, that's a shame. But I'll never forgive them. I will destroy every Type G...
tm.「本当か！？ それは助かるぜ。\n タイプＧの情報を教えよう。ヤツは 常に\n: "Really?! That's a big help. Here's what I know about Type G: it always moves with its killing machine underlings.
tm.「数が少ないから 簡単には見つからないだろうが\n 何度も キラーマシンと戦って: "There aren't many, so it won't be easy to find. But keep fighting killing machines and one will show up.
tm.「キラーマシンは シケスビア雪原にある\n 氷獄の湖の近くで たむろしてるから\: "Killing machines loiter near the Frozen Lake in Snaerfelt, so go there when you look for a Type G.
tm.「じゃあ まずは タイプＧを１体倒して\n ヤツが落とす タイプＧのパーツを届け: "First, defeat one Type G and bring me the Type-G part it drops. I want to see my hated enemy's remains soon...
tm.「タイプＧの情報を教えよう。\n ヤツは 常に 配下のキラーマシンと\n 共に: "Here's what I know about Type G: it always moves with its killing machine underlings.
tm.「おおっ あんたか。もしかして\n タイプＧのパーツを 持ってきてくれたのか？: "Oh, it's you. Could you have brought the Type-G part?
tm.「そうか。たったひとりの肉親を殺した\n タイプＧは 絶対に許さねえ。\n 必ず: "I see. I'll never forgive the Type G that killed my only family. I'll wipe them from this world.
tm.「たしかに これは ヤツのパーツだ。\n へっ どうだ。オレの弟と\n 同じ苦し: "Yes, this is its part. Heh. How does it feel to suffer the same pain as my brother...
tm.「見知らぬ オレの頼みを聞いてくれて\n 礼を言うよ。だが すまない。\n タイ: "Thank you for listening to a stranger's request. But I'm sorry. I've decided to stop destroying Type Gs.
tm.「今 タイプＧのパーツを見て 気づいたんだ。: "Seeing the Type-G part just now, I realized something.
tm.「復讐のために生きる\n 自分もまた タイプＧと同じ\n 殺りくマシーンに なっ: "Living for revenge, I'd become a killing machine just like the Type G.
tm.「オレは 目の前の憎しみに 心奪われ\n やるべきことを見失っていた。\n 本当: "Consumed by hatred in front of me, I lost sight of what I should do. What I really should do is honor my brother...
tm.「だが あんたのおかげで そのことに気づけた。\n これからは 弟の供養に 一生: "But thanks to you, I realized it. From now on I'll devote my life to honoring my brother. Thanks for everything. Take this.
tm.「やあ あんたか。この前は 世話になったな。\n これからは 復讐じゃなく\n: "Oh, it's you. Thanks for the other day. From now on I'll live my own life properly, not for revenge.
tm.「オレが 弟の分まで 幸せに生きること。\n たぶん それが 弟にとって\n い: "I'll live happily for my brother's sake too. I think that's the best way to honor him...

tm.「この森には クレイモランを氷漬けにした\n 魔女と 手下の魔獣がいるらしい。\: "They say a witch and her beast minions in this forest froze Sniflheim. It's dangerous. Leave the forest quickly.
tm.「この森の吹雪を 甘く見ないほうがいいぞ。\n 私も 部隊の者と はぐれてしまっ: "Don't underestimate this forest's blizzard. I got separated from my unit too. It's dangerous. Leave the forest quickly.
tm.「クレイモランの氷漬けをとくため\n 遠路はるばる デルカダールから\n 森にい: "I came all the way from Heliodor to defeat the witch in the forest and undo Sniflheim's freezing.
tm.「だが この吹雪で 隊長を見失ってしまった。\n 隊長は屈強な人物なのだが 寒さ: "But the blizzard made me lose my captain. He's tough, but he hates the cold. I hope he's safe.
tm.「もし 隊長が ひとりで\n 魔女と はち合わせしていたら……。\n そこに魔獣: "If the captain ran into the witch alone... and a beast was there too...
tm.「いくら 隊長が デルカダールでも\n 指折りの実力者とはいえ この天候では\n: "Even if he's one of Heliodor's best, this weather puts him at a disadvantage. I must rejoin him quickly...
tm.「はあ……なんで 貴族のオレが\n こんな辺境の地に 来なくちゃいけないんだよ。: "Sigh... why does a noble like me have to come to a remote place like this? Joining the army was a mistake.
tm.「ムリせず 親父のスネをかじってれば\n 今頃 ソルティコのビーチに行って\n: "If I'd just leeched off my dad, I'd be at the Puerto Valor beach playing with girls right now...
tm.「この城下町は 三層構造になっていて\n 階段の上は お金持ちが住んでいるんだ。: "This town has three tiers. The wealthy live up the stairs. Go straight on and you reach the castle.
tm.「むむっ！？ お前の そのカオ。\n どこかで 見たことが\n あるような ない: "Hm?! That face of yours. I feel I've seen it somewhere... or maybe not...
tm.「……うーん 思いだせないな。\n まぁ いいか。今は そんなことより\n 一刻: "...Hmm, I can't remember. Well, never mind. Right now I must find the Darkspawn at once...
"...Hmm, I can't remember. Well, never mind. Right now I must find the captain at once...
tm.「おお 勇者 {var:1}さま。\n お待ちしておりました。\n デルカダール: "Ah, Luminary {var:1}. We've been waiting. Welcome to Heliodor!
tm.「その節は たいへん ご無礼をいたしました。\n 我々兵士一同 心より 歓迎いた: "Please forgive our terrible rudeness before. All of us soldiers warmly welcome you. Please make yourself at home...!
tm.「おや……勇者さま？\n こんな所で どうされたのですか？\n 今は お城で 宴: "Oh... Luminary? What brings you here? There should be a banquet at the castle now.
tm.「どうぞ お城へお戻りくださいませ。\n 城の者たちが きっと 勇者さまのことを: "Please return to the castle. The castle folk must be worried and searching for you, Luminary.
tm.「お城の者から 聞きましたよ……。\n 王に 魔物が取り憑いていたなんて\n 今: "I heard from the castle folk... that a monster possessed the king. What was I even watching all this time...
tm.「いつも お城に ネズミ１匹入らないように\n 細心の注意を はらってきたという: "I always took great care that not even a mouse got into the castle, yet I missed the change in the king himself...
tm.「へえ 人間が来るなんて めずらしいね。\n ここは いにしえの時代の\n 貴重: "Well, a human, how rare. This is the Ancient Library, which holds precious books from ages past.
tm.「そうだ！ せっかく 来たんだから\n いいこと 教えてあげる。: "I know! Since you came, I'll tell you something useful.
tm.「この図書館にある 色つきの本が入った本棚は\n それぞれの色に対応した スイッ: "The bookshelves with colored books in this library can be moved by pressing the switch of the matching color.
tm.「この図書館にある 色がついた本棚は\n それぞれの色に対応した スイッチを押せ: "The colored bookshelves in this library can be moved by pressing the switch of the matching color.
tm.「ためしに ２階にある 青いスイッチを\n 押してごらん。青い本棚がジャマして\: "Try the blue switch on the second floor. Places the blue shelves blocked will open up.
tm.「それから…… そばに 本が積んである\n 本棚には とっても読みごたえがある\: "Also, the shelves with piled-up books nearby hold very readable books. Give them a read.
tm.「この図書館の始まりは かなり 古くてさ。\n ボクら魔物の親分と 極悪非道の勇: "This library is very old. It was reportedly built before the age of myth, when our monster boss fought the wicked Luminary.
tm.「その時代から すこしずつ 書物が増えていって\n これだけ たくさんの数になっ: "Books gradually piled up since then until we had this many.
tm.「特に そばに本が積んである 本棚には\n とっても 読みごたえがある\n 本が: "Especially the shelves with piled-up books nearby hold very readable books. Give them a read.
